exposure: indications for cesarean section (fetal distress, malpresentation, prolonged and obstructed labor)
cohort: The study included 1763 women who underwent cesarean sections at Ali-Ibn-Abitaleb Hospital in Zahedan city, Iran, between September 2018 and March 2019.
finding: The study found a high overall cesarean section rate of 44.81%, with women with a previous CS (Robson group 5) being the largest contributors, and many CSs were performed in women with low-risk pregnancies.
mod_finding: The overall cesarean section rate was 44.81%, with previous CS being the largest contributor to the overall rate, while adverse maternal outcomes were similar in women with and without a previous CS.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from September 22, 2018, to March 19, 2019.
gest_age: <=36 weeks for pregnancies classified under Robson group 10
